data.value: 1. Managing Rows • NewRow(): Creates a row using table schema. • Rows.Add(): Appends the row to DataTable. • AcceptChanges(): Commits row modifications. 2. Navigation • Browse records by incrementing/decrementing row index pointers. 3. Nulls & 3-Valued Logic • NULL indicates missing or unknown data. • Expressions return True, False, or Unknown. • NULL = NULL evaluates to Unknown. • Any arithmetic with NULL results in NULL.
